title: The Zelda movie’s Ganondorf casting hints at more movies
summary: In a separate report published later on Thursday, Deadline says that Dichen Lachman, Yvonne Strahovski, and the late Sam Neill will be in the Zelda movie as well. Update, August 6th : Adds new casting details from another Deadline report.
